title: Tyler Celotta
text:
Physics student at Reed College in a 3/2 dual degree program — BA Physics at Reed, BS Mechanical Engineering at Columbia. I build things in the shop, model things in code, photograph people and places, and spend too much time outdoors.


About
What I Do



Engineering
Physics and mechanical engineering coursework backed by real shop hours — CNC milling, manual milling, welding, CAD/CAM, and precision metrology. I hold tolerances and take measurement seriously.


Coding
Python & R 
Mathematical modeling, graphical analysis, and data pipelines in Python and R. I've applied these tools to physics lab work, a national math modeling competition, and cost-benefit modeling for public infrastructure proposals.


Portrait Photographer
Operating as Celotta Photos since 2023. Documentary-influenced eye, natural light, authentic moments. Based in Portland during the school year, Twin Cities in summer.


Leadership
Eagle Scout (BSA, 2023). Led a 22-person river rafting Odyssey trip as a certified Wilderness First Responder. Active in public awareness work and community service.

Experience
Where I've Worked



Jun 2025 – Aug 2025
Mechanical Engineering Intern
Twin Cities Makers · Minneapolis, MN
Designed and delivered a 15-hour machining curriculum covering manual milling, lathe turning, and CNC programming. Built a two-stage evaporative cooling prototype achieving ΔT = 5°F at 60% relative humidity. Fabricated a non-sparking propane regulator wrench on a manual mill, holding ±0.003″ tolerance throughout. Installed and maintained shop equipment, facilitated community engagement nights, and helped members troubleshoot mechanical problems.


Aug 2025 – Present
Night Bus Driver
Reed College · Portland, OR
Operate scheduled late-night routes for students and staff across Southeast Portland. Manage vehicle safety checks, mileage logs, and coordination with community safety officers.


Aug 2025 – Sep 2025
Odyssey Trip Leader
Reed College · Deschutes River, OR
Planned, organized, and led a river rafting trip for 22 incoming first-year students on the Deschutes River, operating as a certified Wilderness First Responder throughout.


Oct 2023
Engineering Job Shadow
Medtronic · Minneapolis, MN
Shadowed six biomedical engineers on pacemaker systems R&D. Observed live surgery for procedural analysis and discussed materials and testing protocols for medical-grade components under NDA.


Nov 2021 – Mar 2022
Grant Writer
Centennial School District · Lino Lakes, MN
Co-drafted a grant proposal for a diesel-to-electric school bus fleet conversion. Executed a 30-year cost-benefit analysis using Minnesota state energy data and Excel financial modeling.
